senses.definition: n.pr.loc. (perhaps = יְקָמְעָם i.e. יָ֫קָם עָם Ol§ 277 k, 3; = let the people be established? cf. GrayProp. N. 218);—in N. Isr. 1 K 4:12, Λουκαμ, 𝔊L Ουκαμ; poss. = mod. Tel Ḳaimûn, N. of Megiddo, BuhlGeogr. 210; city of refuge in Ephr. 1 Ch 6:53 (= קִבְצַיִם [q.v.] Jos 21:22), Ικααμ, Ιεκμααν, etc.
